name: Sydney Sweeney
summary: An actress known for Euphoria and The White Lotus who has avoided taking public positions on political issues. Florida voter records show she registered as a Republican in June 2024, and she was drawn into partisan debate over a 2025 American Eagle advertisement. Her only on-record remarks are general: she has said she is against hate and divisiveness and that she will speak when she has an issue she wants to address.

sources.title: Sydney Sweeney addresses American Eagle ad, says she's 'against hate'
sources.author: Matt Lavietes, NBC News (quoting Sweeney's People and GQ interviews)
